lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso, with spacing widest at the mid-section and narrowing towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line from the posterior, splitting approximately one-third of the way down from the dorsal line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several line segments terminate mid-flank, including a short dashed segment between lines 5 and 6 and truncated segments on the lower shoulder area.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 7 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots form a horizontal geometric alignment across the upper mid-section of the hind thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white spots on the facial region (cheek and muzzle); white transverse banding on the lower portions of all four legs; a white patch at the base of the neck.
